goals: Make Block Geometry Extensions geometries participate in Continuity connected-texture behavior when their canonical source or material-family semantics call for connection.
Preserve source-material identity and support applicable BGE-owned geometries consistently without duplicating BGE's canonical geometry ownership, material-family registry, or source-block mappings.
scope: Provide one centralized Fabric block-appearance bridge for Continuity rule selection without generating material- or geometry-specific CTM rules.

Consume BGE's typed canonical binding, state projection, canonical material-face semantics, and exposed surface-patch collection as the sole material and geometry authority rather than inferring families or topology from registry identifiers or Java carrier classes.

Project only explicitly equivalent canonical material state, including world-contextual vanilla snowy semantics for every canonical parent that actually carries SNOWY, while keeping geometry form, orientation, waterlogging, and unknown properties out of the canonical appearance.

Treat Continuity and the active resource pack as the sole material-rule authority by evaluating their connection predicates on BGE-projected canonical material states, then require BGE's physical patch model to prove corresponding face semantics, compatible contact planes, rendered receiver-quad bounds, and real in-plane overlap/contact.

Every canonically bound BGE geometry whose authoritative BGE surface model is supported participates in the same generic Continuity surface semantics, including canonical/full blocks, horizontal slabs, Stairs, Walls, Vertical Slabs, Steps, Layers, Corners, Quarter Columns, and special canonical-bound Farmland Slab where applicable; unknown surface contracts, risky visual profiles, and unrelated Continuity behavior remain fail-closed or unchanged.

exclusions: Continuity remains the target CTM implementation; this project does not replace Continuity or implement a general CTM engine.

BGE retains ownership of geometry registration, geometry ownership, material-family relationships, and source-block mappings; this project must consume those canonical relationships rather than duplicate them or infer them from registry names.
Nibaru retains ownership of its material definitions and semantics.
This project does not modify BGE, Matcha, or unrelated resource-pack artwork during initialization.

Translucent Glass × BGE Compatibility remains a separate project responsible for translucent-glass and rendering compatibility issues that are not general CTM connectivity; this project does not absorb that scope.

state.milestone: Canary 12 updates the controlled provider to exact BGE C78 and consumes every supported canonically bound surface model through one geometry-agnostic resolver, including all 40 resolved Stair states and all 161 nonempty Wall states without Stair/Wall connection branches. C11 per-logical-sprite side/corner provenance, canonical material-face semantics, exact contact planes, typed terrain inset presentation, and receiver-local clipping remain intact. Exact Continuity 3.0.1 source and bytecode show that native Standard Overlay adds no RenderMaterial, decal, blend, depth-bias, or polygon-offset state beyond square geometry, sprite UV, tint, block atlas, animation, chunk layer, item render type, ambient occlusion and emission; C11 already preserved those non-geometric attributes. The remaining render-path difference was differently tessellated coplanar geometry: native full-face overlay and receiver share identical triangles, whereas a clipped projected overlay covered part of one larger receiver triangle pair. C12 delays managed overlay emission, partitions each retained receiver and every represented logical overlay at the same authoritative edges, and emits exact shared cells without epsilon offsets; nominal terrain overlays share their own unchanged presentation-plane grid. Owner evidence is recorded as six individual observations in TESTING.md and CODEX_LOG.md without an aggregate result. C12 has no Minecraft client visual evidence, so shader-off and Complementary depth stability remain owner-runtime checks.

current.summary: Consumes BGE C78 Stairs, Walls, and the complete supported geometry catalog through one surface contract and gives clipped Standard Overlays receiver-matched tessellation without offsets.
